annotations.title: Check a label against a country's label law

description: Check the printed text of a product label against the label law of the country where it is sold. Returns the points to check: each mandatory item found or not found, items needed only in some cases, missing languages, and what to check by eye — each with the law it comes from and, where known, the official text. Key-word check only: not legal advice, never a statement that the label is compliant.

country.description: Where the product is sold: a code from list_markets (us, uk, eu, kr, hk, cn, jp, vn…).

product.description: What the product is: "food" (food and drinks), "cosmetics", "goods" (other consumer goods), "devices" (medical devices: us, eu, fr, es, cy, uk, kr), "supplements", "alcohol", "petfood", "battery", "electrical", "chemical", "toy", "textile" (where the country has them), or a product code from list_markets. Defaults to food.

text.description: Every line printed on the label, one per line, in the language(s) printed.

name: check_label
title: Check a label against a country's label law
